newsitem.title: UK: British Land securitises 114 mln stg loan.
newsitem.headline: British Land securitises 114 mln stg loan.

text.p: The British Land Group Plc said it had completed a 114 million stg securitisation transaction through Thames Asset Global Securitization No. 1 Inc (TAGS) with NatWest Markets.
It said the financing was for 22 years and was secured on the rental stream from a property at 135, Bishopsgate, London EC2 -- the headquarters of NatWest Markets.
British Land said that as a consequence, the company's average weighted debt maturity had risen to 16 years.

The bulk of the 114 million stg has been applied to repayment and cancellation of the existing 98 million stg commercial paper financing secured on 135 Bishopsgate which was jointly arranged by NatWest Markets in 1991.
